commands.command: Inspect installed candidate distribution metadata, package version, CLI --version, EngineClient handshake and bundled engine identity
commands.summary: Distribution name and CLI identity are repopact; distribution/package/CLI/engine handshake all report 3.1.3.dev1, valid=true. Bundled engine hash matches the standalone Cargo engine.

commands.command: Run focused tests.test_engine_client and tests.test_cli_version against installed candidate engine

commands.command: Set REPOPACT_ENGINE to installed stable 3.1.3 engine and invoke candidate 3.1.3.dev1 validation
commands.summary: Candidate failed closed as required with a Rust engine product-version mismatch ('3.1.3' != '3.1.3.dev1'); no fallback occurred. This is an intentional negative compatibility test, not an unresolved release-version mismatch.

environment.identity_contract: VERSION=3.1.3; RELEASE_LABEL=3.1.3-dev.1; PEP 440 distribution/candidate CLI/engine product identity=3.1.3.dev1
environment.interpretation: The stable release base plus the governed development release label intentionally yields the next development identity. All candidate components agree; stable/candidate engine mixing is rejected.
